title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 48 ]

items.text: If I had enough money(Had I enough money), I would buy you a diamond ring.
If I had known your phone number(Had I known your phone number),

blocks.text: I would have given you a ring.

items.text: I wish I had a room reserved for tonight.
I wish I hadn't got a ticket for running a red light.
I wish this were not a formal party.
The missile could have handed Argentina victory in the war.
If they had had the ability to make money(Had they had the ability to make money),

blocks.text: they would have had food and clothes.

items.text: He should be in high school now if he had not flunked a grade. (Had he not flunked a grade, he should be in high school now.)
If the blood products had been heat treated(Had the blood product been heat treated),

blocks.text: they could not have been contaminated by the HIV virus.

items.text: I should have known you were lying.
If only I hadn't promised him.
(Were it not for the sun,) nothing could live.(If it were not for the sun,) nothing could live.
Should I have been(If I had been, had I been) three minutes late, I should have missed the train.
Should you not go, he would go. (If you should not go,) he would go.
